content.introduction: The latest economic indicators from TipRanks.com show a 4.1% unemployment rate as of August 1, 2026, and a real GDP growth of 1.50%. The DWU Consulting data corroborates the unemployment rate at 4.1% and adds that the CPI (YoY) is 3.4%. The TradingEconomics data provides a slightly different unemployment rate of 4.1% as of July 26, 2026, and a GDP growth rate of 1.5% as of June 26, 2026. The sources do not provide a definitive answer on the exact GDP growth rate for October 1, 2026.
